title: kiln-sfi UI transport record, format 1
description: One file between Kiln.Ui and kiln-sfi's Lua runtime, the interpreter's stand-in for ShroudForge 1.7.9's ui/actions and news/events folders. Three kinds: action, notice, and the launch receipt of a launch folder. The mod-page toggle is not a record (it is the named event Local\ShroudForge.ModMenu.Open.<pid>). Closed: no pointers, no Lua references, no field the source does not have. Actions: <game>/kiln/sfi/ui/<launchId>/actions/<requestId>.json, written to the sibling <launchId>/staging/ and renamed in whole (the runtime reads every entry of actions/, so nothing temporary is ever inside it). Kiln.Ui writes <launchId>/launch.json (kind launch) when it makes the folder; only a folder with a receipt whose process has ended is ever pruned, 7 days after its last change, and never through a link. The runtime reads up to 32 entries per turn; a malformed entry or one for an inactive owner, another launch or an old epoch is removed; one whose callback is not registered yet stays (SF dispatch_mod_ui_actions.rs:65-107); the runtime's exact reading rules are schema/fixtures/sfi/ui/drain/cases.json. Notices: <configDir>/sfi/notifications/<keySha256>.json, kept across launches; the key is modId-id as SF writes it, so SF's collisions (a-b/c and a/b-c) share one file and the later write wins. Bytes on disk (schema/fixtures/sfi/ui/wire/): UTF-8 without BOM, no whitespace, no trailing newline, members in this schema's required order (an action's value after action), strings escaped as serde_json and JSON.stringify do (quote, backslash, \b \f \n \r \t, other controls as lower-case \u00xx, everything else raw). Bounds the files cannot say (Kiln's own, where SF has none): a record at most 2 MiB, 1024 pending actions per owner, 4096 notice keys per profile; the numbers are schema/fixtures/sfi/ui/bounds.json. Title and message limits are SF's byte limits; the schema's code-point limits are their loose side, readers check bytes.

launchId.description: sfi.json launch.launchId: kiln.launch's u64 as 16 lower-case hex digits.

launch.description: <game>/kiln/sfi/ui/<launchId>/launch.json: whose folder this is. Kiln.Ui writes it once, staged and renamed, before the first action. The cleanup reads it to prove the launch ended (pid gone, or a process with another start time); without it, or unreadable, the folder is kept.

launchId.description: The folder's name; a receipt naming another launch is not this folder's.

processStartMs.description: sfi.json launch.processStartMs: with pid, the start's identity.

sequence.description: The writer's counter in this launch, for logs; not a dedup key (the source replays a request whose removal failed).

launchId.description: sfi.json launch.launchId; another launch's request is removed unread.

ownerEpoch.description: The requested owner's reload epoch as Kiln.Ui last read it; an old epoch is removed unread.

modId.description: The SF mod whose ui.on_action callback is asked (source key modId).

value.description: Optional text passed to the callback (source key value); absent calls it with nil.

key.description: modId + '-' + the mod's notice id, SF's event key.

keySha256.description: sha256 of key's UTF-8 bytes: the file name.

launchId.description: The launch that published it: provenance only; an older launch's notice stays visible.

notice.description: The payload SF 1.7.9 notifications.publish writes, field for field (create_mod_api.rs:254-263).

level.description: What SF 1.7.9 can store. publish first accepts info, success, warning, error and update (create_mod_api.rs:248), then write_event validates the payload against the embedded event-schema.json, whose level enum is trace, debug, info, warn, error (notifications/event-schema.json, validate_notification_event.rs); success, warning and update therefore fail the publish call with an error and are never written. Same in 1.8.0.

actionUrl.description: Opened only on an explicit click. No length limit, as in SF (publish and event-schema.json set none); the 2 MiB record bound applies.
